headline: Indian stock market crashes as Sensex tanks over 1,400 points led by banking and metal sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking after a four-week rally dragged Indian benchmark shares down.
Heavy selling pressure in banking and financial stocks led market losses.
Metal stocks faced significant decline along with broader financial sector drags.
Fears of a sharp Monday market drop gripped investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex shed over 1,400 points while Nifty fell by 350 points during the session.
Investors lost between Rs 5 lakh crore and Rs 6 lakh crore in total market wealth.
SEBI instructed market players to stop publishing grey market premiums for IPOs.
Mahanadi Coalfields IPO was fully subscribed on its final day of bidding.
summary:
Indian markets witnessed a sharp crash on 23 November 2026 as Sensex dropped over 1,400 points and Nifty plunged below 25,400.
The drop was led by heavy profit-booking in banking, financial, and metal stocks following a four-week rally.
Investors lost over Rs 5 lakh crore in market capitalisation during the sharp sell-off, though some analysts remain optimistic.
